email.subject: Savannah to Memphis container load
email.body:
Hi

We have a loaded 40' container coming off the vessel at the Port of Savannah GA, need it moved to our DC in Memphis. Draying and long haul in one move if you can.

Pick up: Garden City Terminal, 2 Main St, Garden City GA 31408, Tue Nov 24 anytime
Deliver: Delta Home Goods DC, 5100 Airways Blvd, Memphis TN 38116, Wed Nov 25 8:00-16:00

Contents: 24 pallets ceramic tile, 1,950 lbs each, 46,800 lbs total.
Ref: DHG-9917

Let me know the rate.
Tom Reyes, Delta Home Goods
